root_text:
HMPV is not a new virus—it is a common cold virus that has been known for decades. With the increased use of multiplex PCR panels for respiratory infections, it is common to detect HMPV in patients presenting with symptoms of a cold.

MISLE

nodes.text: In fact, even in China, recent data show that 30% of respiratory infections are due to influenza, while only 7% are attributed to HMPV. Influenza, which can cause severe illness and has a higher mortality rate, remains a much greater public health concern than HMPV.

nodes.text:
It is unfortunate that unnecessary panic is being created in the media about human metapneumovirus (HMPV). 

This is highly misleading and unscientific.
